key_insight: An LLM-guided workflow redesigned a magnesium stent across about 1,650 CAD parameters, reducing a high-percentile bend-strain objective by 32% within 15 nonlinear simulations.
engineering_relevance: The approach could enable coordinated component redesign when expensive nonlinear analyses limit the simulation budget.
method: GPT-6 Astra proposed coordinated edits to the stent’s CAD parameters.
Each proposal was built, meshed and simulated with large-deformation plasticity and contact.
The LLM used full simulation results to guide subsequent edits.
evidence_signal: At the same 15-simulation budget, Tosca achieved roughly 10% improvement; an earlier LLM design independently evaluated through full deployment showed 14% lower strain and 63% less damage at its most damaged spot.
watch_item: Results concern one stent case, and the independent higher-fidelity validation tested an earlier design rather than the final 32%-improved design.
paper_title: AI agents can redesign engineering parts with more than a thousand CAD parameters and nonlinear simulations
